title: Mirror Selfie Outdoor Market Stall Rio
description: the market mirror found me again — this time with a bit more confidence, a straighter spine, the stall around me arranged with handmade jewelry and little statuettes of christ the redeemer. #RioDeJaneiro outdoor markets are generous with their mirrors. they want you to see yourself in the context of all this made beauty. #BrazilTravel market mornings are for wandering and trying things on and occasionally buying the necklace.
alt_text: Mirror selfie at outdoor artisan market stall in Rio de Janeiro Brazil showing jewelry displays and Cristo Redentor statuettes

title: Market Stall Mirror Selfie Pose Rio Brazil
description: another market stall, another mirror — this time with more of the scene visible: the beaded curtains, the handmade jewelry on display, the vendor's table crowded with woven goods. #RioDeJaneiro #Ipanema hippie fair is one of the best sunday activities in this city. i keep ending up in these mirrors and i have no complaints. #BrazilTravel: the market selfie is a genre and it deserves respect.
alt_text: Mirror selfie at Ipanema hippie fair market stall in Rio de Janeiro showing beaded curtains and artisan jewelry displays

title: Ipanema Neighborhood Building Ocean View
description: the apartment building across the way — all those balconies stacked with plants, the atlantic visible over its roofline, an island in the distance. this view from my place in #Ipanema, #RioDeJaneiro, is what waking up in this city can look like. the building itself is beautiful: modernist, plant-covered, facing the sea. #BrazilTravel accommodation in the zona sul hits different when this is what you see before coffee.
alt_text: Ipanema residential building with balcony gardens and Atlantic Ocean with island visible in background in Rio de Janeiro Brazil

title: Dois Irmãos Mountain Mist Ipanema Cloudy
description: i never got tired of looking at the dois irmãos from my balcony in #Ipanema. even on the cloudiest days — especially on the cloudiest days — the two peaks held their shape against the gray, a silhouette that belongs to #RioDeJaneiro the way the eiffel tower belongs to paris. #BrazilTravel mountains: the geography of this city is part of its personality. you feel it everywhere.
alt_text: Dois Irmãos Two Brothers mountain peaks visible through clouds over Ipanema from apartment balcony in Rio de Janeiro

title: Rainy Ipanema Morning Balcony View
description: another gray morning on the balcony in #Ipanema, #RioDeJaneiro — the curved railing, the low clouds, the apartment blocks receding toward the mountains. rain came and went all week and i stopped minding it around day three. the city has its own pace in the rain. slower, more interior, more honest. #BrazilTravel rainy season: pack a light jacket and lean into it.
alt_text: Curved balcony railing view over Ipanema neighborhood buildings and mountains in rain in Rio de Janeiro Brazil

title: Ipanema Neighborhood Aerial View Rainy Day
description: the view stretching inland from my window in #Ipanema — buildings layered all the way to the mountains, the streets below lined with mango trees, blue water tanks on rooftops, everything softened by cloud cover. #RioDeJaneiro from above is a dense, layered, gorgeous thing. the mountains never fully disappear. #BrazilTravel neighborhood photography: the residential zones of this city are as compelling as the beaches.
alt_text: Aerial view of Ipanema neighborhood buildings and tree-lined streets toward mountains on rainy day in Rio de Janeiro Brazil

title: Electric Car Rideshare Rainy Rio de Janeiro
description: in the back seat of an electric rideshare in #RioDeJaneiro on a rainy afternoon — the sunroof running with water, the large console screen showing navigation and vehicle status, the city streaking past outside. this is urban travel in brazil in 2024: efficient, modern, the driver calm in traffic. #BrazilTravel logistics: the rideshare infrastructure in #RioDeJaneiro is reliable and worth using daily.
alt_text: Interior of modern electric rideshare car with rain on sunroof and large navigation console in Rio de Janeiro Brazil

title: Galezzo Neon Bar Sign Night Ipanema
description: the sign that led me in — #Galezzo bar and restaurante in #Ipanema, the neon white letters above the stone bar top, the beefeater sign glowing red behind the bottles. i had passed it twice before i finally stopped. the third time the neon was too persuasive. #RioDeJaneiro has bars like this all over zona sul: neighborhood spots with good drinks and no pretense. #BrazilTravel nights belong to places like this one.
alt_text: Neon Galezzo Bar and Restaurante sign glowing at night in Ipanema Rio de Janeiro with bar display and Beefeater gin sign

title: Dark Venue Mural Copacabana Wave Pattern Rio
description: the walls of this dark venue in #RioDeJaneiro were painted with the wave pattern of the #Copacabana promenade, white lines on black, with silhouetted figures in motion: a woman walking, a man on a bicycle, palm trees overhead. red light bled down from the ceiling. it felt like being inside the city's memory. #BrazilArt and #RioNightlife at their most atmospheric.
alt_text: Dark venue wall mural with white line wave pattern and silhouette figures under red light in Rio de Janeiro Brazil

title: Octopus Dish Ipanema Rio Close Up
description: the second look at this octopus dish — the light slightly different, the composition tighter, the plate just as beautiful. i took so many photos because i couldn't decide which one captured it. grilled octopus with herbs and tomatoes at a restaurant in #Ipanema, #RioDeJaneiro. #BrazilianSeafood is a serious and underrated category. this meal alone would justify the trip.
alt_text: Close up of grilled octopus tentacles with fresh herbs cherry tomatoes and aioli on ceramic plate in Ipanema Rio de Janeiro
